Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFExternalSignPrepareResult

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFExternalSignPrepareResult
public final class CPDFExternalSignPrepareResult extends Object
A prepared PDF and its portable signing transaction.

Keep the prepared PDF, complete session and hash together. They must not change between Prepare and Fill. No native handle is retained, and another process may perform Fill. Repeating Prepare may change its bytes, signing time and digest; never mix materials from different preparations.
